method: Diagnostic profile of the PR #606 container JSON_STRING candidate with released Flink 2.2.1/JDK17, four million runtime rows, nullable width-32 ARRAY<VARCHAR(128)>, parallelism one and a 2 GiB heap. JFR profile recording starts after an unprofiled paired stock job and includes native-job setup, processing and teardown. Profiled durations are excluded from every performance median.
interpretation: Inclusive stack occurrence counts overlap and cannot be added. ObjectAllocationSample weight is the sampled allocation-byte estimate, not an exact byte count; it does not measure off-heap allocations. Only ten Java ExecutionSample events were captured, so these data cannot establish CPU-time percentages or prove a dominant bottleneck. NativeMethodSample includes blocked infrastructure threads. The selected areas show allocation/copy work within the production input transpose as well as source/chain copies; this is an investigation direction, not a completed attribution against stock. Java profiles do not reconstruct Rust interior frames.
privacy: Only aggregate counters and public implementation symbols are published. Raw JFR and event dumps remain local because recordings can contain environment/process details.
